title: The night shift's lunch
logline: The lunchroom at 2 AM, 1994: six men instead of forty, pails open, the windows black, the whistle's cord visible through the door. The mill's smaller nights. Era I spotting for the windows.

panels.composition: A mill lunchroom at night with six men from behind at one end of a long table with pails open, black windows, a doorway showing a hanging cord, black spotting in the glass.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, in the Era I manner, heavy black spotting brought back on purpose, a mill lunchroom at night with six men seen from behind at one end of a long table with lunch pails open, black windows and a doorway showing a hanging cord, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
